card_en: Some verbs come with se, which refers back to the subject. Se stays the same for everyone and usually comes second: slabo se počutim, I feel bad; kako se počutiš.

2.pl.note_en: Also the polite you: kako se počutite.

quick_check.explain_en: Počutiti se comes with se, which does not change: slabo se počutim.

helper_de: Like German sich: ich fühle mich. But se stays the same for every person, unlike mich, dich, sich.
helper_en: English says I feel, with no extra word. Slovenian adds se: počutim se, and se stays the same for everyone.
